text:
Type: rectangular storage ottoman bench
Use: seating and hidden storage; bedroom, living room, entryway
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, dark block feet
Colors: medium cool grey, black
Shape: boxy rectangular body, button-tufted lift-up lid, low padded end rails, short square feet, low and bulky
Feel: soft, practical, calm
Goes with: grey and white textiles, light or dark wood; modern bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: Amazon Basics Rectangular Storage Ottoman Bench with Fabric Upholstery, Large - Anchor Grey
product.description: This product was previously sold as First Hill and now as Amazon Basics Rectangular ottoman bench with lift-open lid and roomy interior storage Durable wood construction with rubberwood feet for strength and stability Linen-look fabric upholstery with a dramatic tufted finish for timeless, sophisticated style Child-safety hinge prevents lid from slamming shut; ideal for an entryway, living room, family room, or bedroom Measures 20 x 51 x 17.5 inches (LxWxH)
